gate_objections: part 4 (pages 28-33): U1: the jump for code 11/12/13 is not the issue, but U2 is given a condition (@[U1] in [11,12,13]) that is not printed in the source; U2 is simply the next question and the routing is carried by the jumps. Remove the invented condition, or record it as a jump consequence only.

part 4 (pages 28-33): U3 has no entry reflecting that U2 is skipped when U1 routes to U3; more importantly U4 condition and the U1 jump list are fine, but the U1 jump for code 00 to U12 and 05-10 to U3 are recorded while U2's condition duplicates them (resolving jumps into conditions on skipped questions is the host's job).

part 4 (pages 28-33): U7, U8, U9, U10 carry conditions on U6 that resolve the jumps U6→U8 and U6→U11 into conditions. The source has only the jumps; the conditions on skipped questions should be removed (U7 @[U6]==7, U8/U9/U10 @[U6] in [7,8]).

part 4 (pages 28-33): U4 condition (@[U3]==3), U14 condition (@[U13]!=0), U33 and U34 conditions (@[U32]==1) likewise resolve printed jumps into conditions on the skipped questions; the host resolves jumps, so these should be removed.

part 4 (pages 28-33): U30 'Go to U39' printed after the Yes follow-up is recorded as a jump from 'U30b', which is not a printed question id; the jump should leave from U30 (or the leaving question as printed) with when @[U30]==1. Also the follow-ups invented ids U11a, U12a, U21a, U30a, U30b, U38a, U39a, U40a, U41a-f are not printed ids; the sub-options (languages, income/loss amounts, bracket narrowing) should be options/parts of the parent question rather than new questions.

part 4 (pages 28-33): U11/U12/U21 codes: U11 Yes is printed as code 1 and sub-options 3,4,5; U11a lists values 1,2,4 with labels '3 — English' etc., so the printed codes 3/4/5 are not used as the values; same for U12a (5,6,7), U15 (printed 1-9 but values are bit flags 1,2,4,...,256), U37 (5,6,7), and Appendix C e (printed 1-6 coded as bit flags). Option codes must be the printed codes.

part 4 (pages 28-33): U39 is split into U39 (amount) and U39a (No income/Don't know), and U38/U40 in the source print Income/Loss amounts as part of the options; U41 nested brackets are not separate questions. This misrepresents the printed structure.

part 4 (pages 28-33): U10 check (@[U10] >= @[U5]) is marked invented true, but the hint is in Spanish while the rest of the source is English; and U26 <= U24 check is acceptable but U24/U26 'max 99' bounds are not printed. Remove unprinted bounds.

part 4 (pages 28-33): Appendix B: printed items missing from the questions or scope: item 20 and 30, 51, 53 are put in scope as 'in' but are not questions (fine), but item 32/52 etc. are fine; however Appendix B items 10-16 call record and other labelled fields (1-4 telephone label, 70-73 designated day label) are said out; yet items 70-73 and 36 'SEL #' etc. are acceptable. Item 49 and 50 follow-ups ('Enter names and complete items 37 through 48') have no jump entries.

part 4 (pages 28-33): Appendix B item 45 condition uses @[37], an age on the same roster line, which is not a defined question id per line and is not an external; the roster rows repeat 8 times but are recorded once without saying so in scope.

part 4 (pages 28-33): Appendix C 'e' condition uses predicate '1 == 1' (a placeholder always-true predicate) and the item 32 → 49 jump uses 'when 1 == 1' and leaves from 48; these are not meaningful conditions.
